quote: Old Cipher amended its loan agreement with Bitfury Holding B.V. to: (i) amend the original loan facility amount of $100,000 to the actual disbursement under the loan of $7,038,038 (the "Actual Disbursement") and (ii) amend the interest to 2.5% per annum
